pages.text: Chase affixed drops — the random modifiers on weapons and armor from mobs and bosses. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds $(bold)88 custom affix entries$() on top of Apotheosis's built-in pool, including 5 End-themed affixes exclusive to End dimension loot.$(br2)Affixes also provide $(bold)gem sockets$(). Higher-rarity affixed items have more sockets. $(l:icraft:loot/gems)See the Gems entry$(/l) for socket details.

pages.title: Affix Tiers
pages.text: $(bold)Common$() — Available $(t1)Tier 1$()+. Mild bonuses. 0-1 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Uncommon$() — Available $(t2)Tier 2$()+. Moderate bonuses. 1-2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Rare$() — Available $(t2)Tier 2$()+. Strong bonuses. 2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Epic$() — Available $(t3)Tier 3$()+. Very strong bonuses. 2-3 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Legendary$() — Available $(t4)Tier 4$(). Exceptional bonuses. 3-4 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Mythic$() — Post-endgame Rift infusion only. Maximum bonuses. 4 sockets.

pages.title: Reforging
pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$()'s Reforging Station allows replacing an item's affixes with newly-rolled ones. $(thing)IridescentCraft$() adds three reforge token tiers that control the minimum affix quality:$(br2)$(bold)Basic Reforging Token$() — minimum Uncommon$(br)$(bold)Advanced Reforging Token$() — minimum Rare$(br)$(bold)Ultimate Reforging Token$() — minimum Epic$(br2)These reforging tokens are crafted from boss materials at the reforging stations. They are separate from progression tokens — see $(l:icraft:loot/token_system)Progression Tokens$(/l).

pages.title: End-Themed Affixes
pages.text: The End rolls $(bold)5 exclusive affixes$() on its loot drops. They interact with the End's unique mechanics — Void Proximity damage scaling, Ender Displacement teleportation, and Void Corruption — and are among the most powerful in the game.$(br2)End affix gear pairs well with the $(bold)Voidward$() and $(bold)Warp Shield$() enchantments for maximum End survivability.$(br2)$(bold)Next: socket your best drop — $(l:icraft:loot/gems)Apotheosis Gems$(/l).$()
